Primary request: A single isolated floating island base for a modern cozy life simulation game, inspired by the clean, rounded, colorful 3D visual qualities of Animal Crossing: New Horizons and Kirby and the Forgotten Land. Original environment only, no copyrighted characters, logos or UI.
Style/medium: Premium contemporary console game asset with smooth matte simplified materials, bold clean silhouettes, very sparse large details, soft ambient occlusion and playful polished 3D forms. notes: Six broad buildable lawns visible, one coral-roof cream cottage rear-left, one rounded green tree rear-right, turquoise pool and front waterfall.
Canvas margins are about 2–3%, tighter than the requested 5%, but whole silhouette is inside frame.
Much simpler and brighter than prior art; some mild clay surface texture, grass edge leaves, and small decorative flowers remain.

Suggested lawn anchors based on visible lawn centers, in approximate percent canvas coordinates: [34,29], [61,25], [54,36], [19,40], [68,48], [83,40]. Adjust consuming placement geometry to these actual regions.
